# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

## Verification-environment mismatch (mechanism)
- What worked: parsing traces into user-turns + agent tool-calls + gold action_checks reveals the EXACT wrong write, which is the reliable way to name a cluster's root cause. (procedure, cand_0001)
- What didn't (caution, not yet a RESULT): the proposer's local base DB differs from the eval task-DBs, so reward-effect can't be confirmed locally — verify tool LOGIC on controlled inputs, never assume base-DB dates/prices match eval.
- Promising but not yet tried / not yet scored (cand_0001, awaiting RESULT): (a) in-body cancel guard on past-dated flights; (b) book_reservation payment auto-resolve with payment_history re-sync (credit card absorbs remainder → gold's canonical split); (c) additive list_reservations loop tool for route-based reservation lookup. All three functionally verified; effect on val to be confirmed by this candidate's RESULT.
